anomalies.description: CRITICAL INFRA BUG (first found by a prior run, still unfixed): this repository has no shared 'main' branch. origin/HEAD is permanently pinned to the bootstrap commit d569736, and every scheduled run creates a brand-new orphan branch ('claude/clever-thompson-XXXXXX') off that same bootstrap commit instead of continuing from the previous run's state. Over 30 such sibling branches exist as of 2026-09-20T07:16Z, none merged into any shared branch. Consequence: state.json/journal updates never actually carry over between runs; every run re-derives the account snapshot live (which is why no incorrect data has surfaced so far) but cumulative fields that MUST persist across runs to enforce the rules -- day_trades (PDT rolling 5-day count), stopped_out_recently (re-entry cooldown), candidates_seen, and true peak_account_value history -- cannot actually accumulate. No incorrect trade has resulted yet only because signals have been absent and buying power has been $0.60 since bootstrap. Also observed: the routine appears to be firing roughly hourly, including all weekend, rather than the 2x/weekday cadence the design (AGENT.md Part 1) describes, which is a real usage-cost concern separate from the persistence bug. Pushed a 'main' branch from this run's consolidated state as a stopgap so a continuation point exists; the owner still needs to point the routine/environment at a stable branch (e.g. always checkout+push 'main') rather than letting the harness assign a fresh branch per session. Owner notified via push notification this run.
anomalies.action_taken: flagged to owner; pushed consolidated state to a new 'main' branch as a stopgap; no trades placed or orders modified. Update 2026-09-20T08:15Z: this run continued from origin/main successfully (state.json/journal history is carrying over on main now), so the persistence half of the bug is mitigated as long as the routine keeps pushing to main. The cadence/orphan-branch-creation issue itself (still firing far more often than 2x/weekday, and each session still starts on a fresh claude/clever-thompson-* branch rather than main) is an environment/routine configuration issue outside this run's control and remains unfixed; not re-notifying the owner since this is unchanged from the prior report. Update 2026-09-20T17:32Z: root-caused via the GitHub API (search_repositories) -- the repo's default_branch is still 'claude/clever-thompson-2hr5eq' (the original bootstrap-era branch), never changed to 'main'. That's exactly why fresh sessions keep cold-starting: whatever checks out 'the repo' at session start checks out the configured default branch, not main. No tool available to this agent can change a repo's default branch (that's a GitHub repo-settings write, not exposed by any connected tool) -- this is now explicitly the owner's one remaining manual step (Settings -> General -> Default branch -> main), called out at the top of AGENT.md. Talked to the owner directly this run (live chat, not push notification): confirmed they want the hourly cadence kept as-is, they just don't want an email for every no-op run. Tightened AGENT.md with an explicit Section 8 notification policy (notify only on: order activity, a position closing, a halt/limit tripping or clearing, a genuinely new anomaly, or a run that failed to complete -- never for restating an already-known, unchanged anomaly or a clean reconciliation), and added a live dashboard (Artifact, URL in this file's dashboard_url) that gets updated and linked whenever a notification is actually sent, replacing the plain-text-only report.
